protocol: Reuse exactly the v6.8 first eligible EARLY_CANDIDATE_SHADOW LONG per UTC day and localStructure.sweptLowReclaimed flag. Classification at end of candidate's 15-minute closed bar. Do not tune or change definition after seeing historical results.
primary: Original v7.0 symbol-month guarded event-weighted Sweep minus non-Sweep difference in average 4h/24h forward close-to-close % return, excluding each symbol-month with empty comparison group; all 81 months must pass source guards
prespecifiedAnalysis: calendar-year 2020 through 2026, both horizons, both BTC/ETH
asset split BTC and ETH, with sample sizes
pre-institutional reference 2020–2023 and ETF-era 2024–Sep 2026 as contextual split, never causal attribution to ETF
calendar quarter clustered bootstrap 12000 replications jointly preserving BTC/ETH symbol-month dependence and within-quarter serial correlation
calendar year leave-one-year-out, separate year descriptive effects
first-LONG events split into UTC-day parity 0/1 for disjoint 24-hour windows per asset
retrospective past-only trailing-24h return regime UP>1% DOWN<−1% otherwise SIDEWAYS, descriptive only
compare all 42 historical symbol-months with immutable archived v7.3 before acceptance
accept: 81 full, gapless BTC and 81 full, gapless ETH UTC month ZIPs
ZIP CRC, OHLC and 5m sequence, R2 bytes SHA-256 match metadata and quality=full
identical shared-event monthly results with v7.3 for prior 42 symbol-months
R2 versioned 7.5 report and manifest readback by SHA256
limitations: Full retrospective cycle, not forward validation
2020-2024 prior halving cycle covered; 2024-2028 cycle only partially observed
Market context and ETFs do not prove causal change in trading edge
No returns-cost execution evaluation, maker/taker fees, impact, funding, orderbook/OI, or live Detector parity
No factor promotion, portfolio or Futures writes, orders or trading signals
Known 21 months were inspected in earlier research; 60 remaining were not part of v6.8-v7.3 studies, not guaranteed new to all possible historical research
Multiple testing and exploratory regimen diagnostics mean any discoveries need independent prospective confirmation
altExtension: After BTC/ETH v7.5 core cycle research, independently audit SOL/BNB/LINK/XRP/ADA/DOGE with actual listing calendars, avoid survivorship bias. Never backfill before symbol listing.
